handoff.salientSummary: Implemented repository layer with connection pool (25 max connections), CRUD operations for evaluations, results, and predictions, transaction support, JSONB query helpers, and pagination logic. All 23 tests pass with 79.4% coverage.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created database.go with pgxpool connection pool (25 max connections), transaction support via BeginTx. Implemented EvaluationRepository with Create/GetByID/List/UpdateStatus/Delete/Count/CountByStatus methods, including pagination with LIMIT/OFFSET ordered by created_at DESC. Implemented ResultRepository with JSONB metrics support and QueryByMetrics helper. Implemented PredictionRepository with batch insert transaction support. Added comprehensive tests verifying: created_at auto-population, status timestamp updates (started_at, completed_at), JSONB metrics storage and query, batch insert, pagination, and foreign key enforcement.
